Three individuals arrested in Rajasthan for allegedly practicing as doctors with fake certificates

Rajasthan's Special Operations Group (SOG) has arrested three individuals accused of practicing medicine in a government hospital using fraudulent FMGE certificates. This operation is part of a larger investigation into a certificate scam, with previous arrests including a former registrar, bringing the total number of arrests in the case to 28. The accused allegedly purchased the fake certificates for a significant sum.
